Pages index.html — homepage and featured work about.html — profile, MBK identity and learning interests projects.html — MBK Global, MBK TV, MBK Markets, MBK Downloader, Text to Handwriting, Noor-e-Quran and more gallery.html — self-hosted image-only gallery blog.html — seven long-form articles about Bakhtawar Khan and the MBK projects news.html — short notes and updates social.html — social profiles contact.html — contact links privacy-policy.html — privacy information Run locally Open index.html in a browser, or use VS Code Live Server. No build step is required. Deploy to Vercel Import the repository in Vercel and use the project root as the root directory. This is a static HTML site, so no framework build command is needed. Before publishing Verify every project and social link. Confirm the canonical domain in sitemap.xml, robots.txt and structured data. The sitemap currently uses https://muhammad-bakhtawar-khan.vercel.app. Replace sample or outdated project details with current, verified information. Gallery images are stored locally in assets/images/gallery/. The articles are editorial introductions; update them when there are specific new features, measurable outcomes or project milestones to report. Contact Email: Bakhtawark085@gmail.com WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923200276941 Latest portfolio refinements Homepage portrait has no decorative circle/orbit overlays; the photograph remains the focus. Personal branding uses “Founder of MBK Global”; use “Founder & CEO” only after explicit owner confirmation. SEO keyword metadata includes Bakhtawar Khan, MBK, MBK Bakhtawar, MBK Global and the related project names across relevant pages. SEO package SEO-CHECKLIST.md — launch and Search Console checklist SEO-KEYWORD-MAP.md — keyword clusters mapped to relevant pages sitemap.xml — core pages, standalone articles and image URLs robots.txt — sitemap declaration Seven standalone article-*.html pages with unique titles, descriptions, canonical URLs and BlogPosting structured data SEO aims to help real visitors find relevant content. It does not guarantee Google indexing, rankings, sitelinks or a knowledge panel. Confirm the deployed domain before publishing. Services page The new services.html page provides a detailed overview of design, web/app development, API integration, WhatsApp bots, AI and workflow automation, SEO, advertising creatives, video, authorized code analysis, deployment and consulting. Review service descriptions and scope before publishing. Gallery: 23 images Place your images in assets/images/gallery/ and name them Image 1 through Image 23. Supported extensions are .jpg, .jpeg, .png, and .webp (uppercase extensions also work). The gallery tries supported extensions automatically and keeps the image order. For best performance, use compressed WebP/JPEG files and descriptive alt text is provided in the page. Services SEO The services.html page includes a unique title and meta description, canonical URL, social sharing metadata, and JSON-LD structured data. Keep the service descriptions accurate to what you can deliver; do not add repetitive keyword lists or promise guaranteed rankings. Gallery image hosting The gallery uses 25 direct public GitHub raw URLs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Muhammad-Bakhtawar-Khan/myimages/main/image1.jpeg through image25.jpeg. Ensure the repository is public and every filename exists exactly as written (case-sensitive). gallery.html contains descriptive alt text, lazy loading, responsive layout, Open Graph image metadata, ImageGallery structured data, and the gallery image sitemap entries. Launch readiness additions LAUNCH-READY-CHECKLIST.md identifies included updates and the owner-only steps that still require real account/domain details. 404.html provides a not-found page; thank-you.html is reserved for a future connected form and does not send messages by itself. vercel.json adds basic security response headers. sitemap.xml includes public HTML pages and excludes noindex utility pages. Analytics and a backend contact form are intentionally not fabricated or enabled without the required IDs/provider. Professional expansion (October 2026) Added pages: case-studies.html, hire-me.html, and resources.html. Added practical articles: article-react-performance.html, article-api-integration.html, article-ai-automation.html, and article-technical-seo.html. The Blog page links to the new articles, the sitemap includes the new URLs, and the existing visual design system is reused. Before publishing: check the canonical domain against the actual deployed domain, test all pages on a phone and desktop, verify each project link, confirm WhatsApp form behaviour, and only publish project metrics/testimonials that can be substantiated. Search rankings are not guaranteed. FAQ update: FAQ content has been moved to the dedicated faq.html page and a FAQ navigation link has been added across HTML pages. FAQ blocks were removed from individual pages to reduce repetition. Creative FAQ refresh The dedicated faq.html page now includes topic filters, live search, indexed accordion answers, responsive layout, keyboard focus styles, and a project enquiry CTA. Shared CSS includes restrained hover, focus, and reduced-motion refinements. Portfolio update (October 2026): the Services page now features a creative MBK Service Approach guide; About includes the requested professional focus areas; Projects lists MBK Text to Speech, MBK Number to Info, MBK DP Finder, MBK Bot, and a “More Projects Coming Soon! — By MBK Global” panel. Upcoming items are labelled as in development and are not presented as launched products. Identity and SEO architecture update about-muhammad-bakhtawar-khan.html — factual founder profile and Q&A. official-links.html — centralized public links and associated project directory. web-development.html, ai-api-integration.html, technical-seo.html, cybersecurity.html, digital-branding.html — service-specific landing pages with scope and limitations. identity-config.json — maintainer-facing identity/contact/project source and verification notes. IDENTITY-SEO-IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT.md — implementation summary, live checks and owner review items. Book a Call now prepares the request in WhatsApp; the visitor must press Send. The robots policy allows OAI-SearchBot for search discovery while keeping GPTBot disallowed. Neither crawling access nor structured data guarantees indexing or AI citation. Identity configuration and validation identity-config.json is the maintainer source for the public identity, contact, profile and project records. scripts/sync_identity.py synchronizes contact values and primary entity JSON-LD and rebuilds the canonical sitemap. Review the diff before deployment. scripts/validate_identity.py checks the core configuration, JSON-LD blocks, sitemap and required pages. Run with python scripts/validate_identity.py. IDENTITY-CONTENT-ARCHITECTURE.md documents the question-answer and page-link architecture. POST-DEPLOYMENT-MONITORING.md lists launch and monitoring checks.
